notes: Flagged unit millebad (mi + le + bad → Besides) accounted morpheme by morpheme: the מִן carries the separative, the לְ is the compound's linking element, and בַּד carries the lexeme. No English word answers to any one of them, so rule 30's one-rendering condition holds and the group is genuinely indivisible; retained, headed on בַּד under rule 23.
The prepositional predicate of the relative clause carries the supplied copula (rule 49), and the article on ha-tamid is unrepresented because the ASV writes a continual burnt offering with no the.
